jobs.title: Oracle Cloud (OCI) Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Role: Oracle Cloud (OCI) Solutions Architect
Location: [Chicago, IL, 60606], United States
 
 
Job Description
seeking a hands-on Oracle Cloud (OCI) Solutions Architect to support a client OCI implementation. This role will play a critical part in designing, validating, and ultimately owning our OCI environment supporting Oracle Fusion applications (HCM, EPM, ERP) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
 
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work with implementation partner to review and validate OCI architecture and design decisions.

Establish standards and best practices across OCI and Oracle Fusion (HCM, EPM, FAH, FDI).
Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and operationally sustainable.
Drive transition from implementation to internal ownership, including documentation and knowledge transfer.

jobs.title: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence & Oracle Analytics Cloud
jobs.description:
Role: Principal Consultant - Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence & Oracle Analytics Cloud 
Bay area, CA or relocation
Role Overview 
As a Principal Consultant, you will be a solution delivery lead, responsible for the end-to-end implementation of Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence Cloud Solution for a portfolio of Oracle Cloud ERP customers. Leveraging your expertise in Oracle Datawarehouse Cloud solutions such as OAC, ODI, FDI, BIP, OTBI etc. and solution delivery leadership, you will lead teams to deliver innovative, high-quality solutions that meet clients' business needs. This role requires a proactive approach, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build collaborative relationships with clients and internal teams. 
Key Responsibilities 
Project Delivery 

Lead FDI Analytics projects from initiation to completion, ensuring the delivery of innovative solutions aligned with client priorities. 
Lead and collaborate with onshore and offshore project team, ensuring alignment with broader business goals and strategies. 

Client Engagement 

Actively build positive, collaborative relationships with clients to understand their business priorities. 
Advise clients on using Oracle FDI Cloud to meet their business needs regarding Analytics across Oracle HCM, Financials, SCM Cloud modules and CX Modules. 
Identify stakeholders across customer and internal team and perform deep stakeholder analysis including resource backfills and resource contingency planning. 

Solution Design 

Collaborate with key stakeholders, including business leaders and IT teams, to understand business requirements related to Analytics within Oracle Cloud solutions such as HCM, ERP, SCM, EPM, CX, etc. 
Design end-to-end solutions based on best practices enabled by Oracle FDI Cloud modules to meet business objectives and analytics requirements. 
Lead the implementation of Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) across Oracle Cloud solutions such as HCM, ERP, SCM and CX, ensuring alignment with best practices and industry standards. 
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for solution architecture, configurations, and integrations. 
Ensure that documentation is accessible and understandable to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Problem Solving and Mitigation 

Deep-dive into existing and potential problem areas, developing corrective action and mitigation plans. 
Be hands-on when needed to help teams solve problems and achieve successful resolutions. 

Continuous Learning and Innovation 

Stay current on market innovations, Oracle FDI Cloud methodologies, tooling, and assets/accelerators. 

Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with at least 10 years of Information Technology experience in Oracle or any other Tier 1 ERP application. 
Minimum of 5 years’ experience delivering and managing complex implementation of Analytics solution leveraging OTBI, BIP, OAC, ODI & FDI across Oracle Cloud ERP, SCM, SCP, EPM, HCM, CX, etc. 
Minimum 5 years’ experience in Data augmentation, semantic modeling, extending data with custom applications and managing data connections. 
Expertise in building custom subject areas, Data visualizations, Data sets, Data flows and data replication.  
Minimum of 5 years’ experience managing a team of Oracle FDI Cloud resources, onshore and offshore. 
Deep experience in implementing FDI for Oracle Financials & SCM Cloud is preferred. 
Full life cycle implementation experience including Design, Configure Test and Deploy phase. 
Experience in design implementation, testing and deploying of Business process controls, automated controls, and IT controls. 
Certifications in Oracle FDI Cloud are preferred. 
Understanding of Oracle Cloud configurations as it relates to the design and development of Analytics in FDI. 
Prior experience with managing Oracle Cloud ERP programs at Big4 or other leading consulting firms is preferred. 
Prior experience with coordinating Oracle FDI projects with Oracle Sales Team, Oracle Support Team, Oracle Customer Success Team is preferred. 
Strong grasp of core data warehouse concept and design paradigms.  
Solid understanding of Oracle’s analytics offerings including OAC, OBIEE, OBIA, RPD, Machine Learning and Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).  
Knowledge of Oracle Cloud Financial System modules - General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Asset Management also desirable.  
Experience of working with DA scripts and handling Frequent data refresh  
Experience with common web connectivity and integration standards/protocols like XML, SOAP, REST, JSON and JDBC.  
Experience interfacing with enterprise applications, databases, service layers, and message queues.  
Experience with relational (SQL) & NoSQL databases.  
Experience with Cloud Platforms like Oracle, AWS, Google, Azure, Salesforce.  
Strong academic background with hands-on database programming, algorithms, and implementation.  
Desire & ability to work in a team environment and train on new technologies

jobs.title: Cloud/Platform/Systems Specialist
jobs.description:
Role: Cloud/Platform/Systems Specialist 
Location: Des Moines, IA 
 

The Service Delivery Public Safety IT Team is seeking a candidate for a critical cloud/platform/systems specialist to Support senior resources. Expectations include Leading infrastructure initiatives to modernize IT infrastructure and operations to enhance efficiency, scalability, and reliability across hybrid cloud environments. This role supports enterprise modernization goals by providing support for modern approaches to hybrid-cloud administrative and engineering practices to eliminate expensive and inefficient legacy solutions, while improving operational efficiency, reducing manual intervention, and enabling scalable infrastructure solutions.
 
5 or more years of experience required in the following areas:

Designs, maintains, and optimizes hybrid platforms that bridge on‑premises infrastructure with AWS cloud services, aligning with the shift toward cloud‑centric operations:
- Designing and administering AWS environments (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3) to support enterprise workloads.
- Creating hybrid workload patterns where identity, authentication, and application services function seamlessly across cloud and on‑premises systems.
- Migrating legacy systems to AWS, including developing modernization roadmaps and workload readiness assessments.
- Documenting system architectures and producing AWS architecture diagrams showing network topology, dependencies, and service interactions.

Provides senior‑tier support for issues escalated from Service Desk, Applications, Networking, or automation teams:
- Diagnosing complex AWS identity, network, or compute issues affecting dependent applications.
- Documenting troubleshooting workflows, root causes, and long‑term mitigation strategies.
- Guiding teams through hybrid dependency failures such as directory sync disruptions, routing conflicts, or misconfigured IAM policies.

Ensures platform resilience by monitoring, optimizing, and maintaining cloud and on‑prem compute, storage, networking, and identity components:
- Eliminate single points of failure in designs patterns
- Provide backup, recovery, and DR to meet all RTO/RPO requirements.
- Implementing performance dashboards covering compute utilization, storage I/O, and network throughput across AWS and on‑prem.
- Conducting root‑cause analysis for performance issues and documenting remediation steps.
- Identifying cost optimization opportunities through instance rightsizing, storage tier adjustments, and lifecycle automation.
- Maintaining architecture diagrams, standards, IaC manifests, and operational procedures in version‑controlled environments.
- Preparing change impact statements for major infrastructure modifications.
- Creating release documentation for platform updates promoted through CI/CD pipelines. Ensuring consistency across platform standards, enforcement rules, and automation artifacts.

Works closely with automation specialist and other team members to ensure infrastructure deployments follow consistent, automated, and auditable patterns:
- Defining IaC patterns and collaborating on Terraform module designs.
- Documenting provisioning workflows, configuration standards, and parameter usage for automated deployments.
- Supporting CI/CD infrastructure pipelines that promote test, staging, and production environments through automated checks.
- Collaborate with engineering and application teams to optimize workloads for hybrid cloud environments.
- Provide guidance on migration strategies, performance tuning, and cost optimization for hybrid-cloud deployments.

Maintain comprehensive documentation for hybrid cloud architecture, operational procedures, and automation workflows. Ensure documentation supports knowledge transfer and compliance audits.

Supports organizational security and compliance goals by implementing and documenting platform controls across cloud and on‑prem environments. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Enforcing AWS guardrails such as encryption, MFA, IAM role boundaries, and network segmentation.
- Producing audit evidence packages (configuration exports, pipeline logs, screenshots).
- Documenting platform hardening guidelines for compute, identity, and storage systems.
- Creating policy interpretation guides to clarify required platform configurations for other technical teams.
- Writing operational guides, onboarding materials, and “how‑to” documentation for AWS and hybrid operations.
- Delivering platform standards, architecture reference materials, and annotated diagrams explaining system interactions.
- Producing executive‑level briefings summarizing modernization progress and platform initiatives.

Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior Vulnerability Management Remediation Lead to drive enterprise-wide vulnerability remediation efforts to completion. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role requiring deep Tanium expertise, strong technical skills, and the ability to hold teams accountable for remediation outcomes.
This individual will not only perform patching and remediation but will also lead remediation initiatives, escalate blockers, track progress, and ensure vulnerabilities are driven to closure. Key Responsibilities

•            Escalate aging or high-risk vulnerabilities and remove organizational roadblocks.

•            Develop and manage patching campaigns, maintenance windows, and emergency deployments. 
•            Validate remediation through rescans, reporting, and compliance verification. 
•            Analyze vulnerability trends and provide executive-level reporting and risk summaries. 
•            Track remediation metrics (MTTR, SLA compliance, critical vulnerability aging). 
•            Lead remediation efforts for zero-day and critical vulnerabilities. 
•            Implement process improvements to enhance remediation efficiency and coverage. 
•            Mentor junior team members and promote remediation best practices. 
________________________________________
Required Qualifications 
•            5+ years of experience in vulnerability management, patch management, or systems engineering. 
•            Deep hands-on experience with Tanium (Patch, Comply, Deploy, Interact, Asset) in large enterprise environments. 
•            Strong Windows and/or Linux systems administration background. 
•            Experience working with vulnerability scanning platforms (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7). 
•            Proven experience driving remediation programs to closure across multiple teams. 
•            Strong understanding of CVSS, risk prioritization, and exploitability analysis. 
•            Experience delivering executive-level reporting and risk presentations. 
•            Strong knowledge of change management and enterprise IT operations. 
________________________________________
Preferred Qualifications 
•            Experience integrating Tanium with ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms. 
•            Experience in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, federal). 
•            Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST frameworks, or other compliance standards. 
•            Automation/scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, Bash). 
•            Tanium Certified Operator or equivalent certifications. 
________________________________________
Key Competencies 
•            Results-driven and persistent — pushes remediation efforts to completion. 
•            Strong leadership presence without direct authority. 
•            Ability to influence cross-functional teams and enforce accountability. 
•            Exceptional organizational and follow-up skills. 
•            Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
•            Comfortable presenting remediation status and risk exposure to senior leadership. 
•            Ability to operate with urgency in high-risk scenarios. 
 
What Success Looks Like 
•            Critical vulnerabilities remediated within SLA. 
•            Reduction in vulnerability aging backlog. 
•            Improved MTTR and compliance metrics. 
•            Clear executive visibility into remediation status and risk posture. 
•            Documented and repeatable remediation processes.

Operating within GDOT’s enterprise IT environment, the TPM is responsible for assessment of specialized applications, platforms or data product requests. This role requires a blend of business acumen and a deep understanding of technical architecture, system integrations, and data structures.
Core Responsibilities
1.Stakeholder Management & Requirement Engineering

Act as the primary liaison between business units (e.g., Engineering, Planning, Operations), executive leadership, and internal/external engineering teams.
Lead discovery sessions to uncover and analyze deep user needs, transforming vague business requests into highly structured, prioritized product backlogs.
Translate complex business processes into technical specifications, system architecture maps, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria for developers.

2.Technical Leadership & Platform Governance

Collaborate closely with enterprise architects, security teams, and database administrators to evaluate technical feasibility, manage system dependencies, and mitigate technical risks.
Ensure all product features conform to internal IT governance frameworks, state agency security protocols, and strict regulatory or federal compliance standards.
Evaluate APIs, data integration plans, and existing software capabilities within the IT and Transportation Tech markets to determine buy-vs-build strategies.

3.Communication

 Establish and enforce a protocol for consistent and detailed documentation for all developed solutions to be used by both internal and external resources (GDOT and suppliers).
Document and present status updates to stakeholders and management

4.Continuous Process Improvement & Documentation

Identify opportunities to optimize the IT project intake, evaluation, and prioritization processes using data-driven insights.
Develop, standardize, and maintain guidelines, templates, operating procedures, and training materials to help business users submit high-quality project requests.
Draft formal technical policies, agency guidance documentation, and system regulations for management approval within assigned timeframes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience: 4+ years of product management or technical program management experience, preferably within a government agency, enterprise IT, or transportation technology ecosystem.
Technical Acumen: Familiarity with data pipelines, GIS/spatial data systems, cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS), or enterprise service platforms (e.g., ServiceNow).
Vendor Management: Experience overseeing outsourced or contractor-led software development efforts is highly desirable
